inspiration.observed_pattern: EXPORT_SET converts one integer mask into a fixed-width separator-delimited bit label string.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one scalar EXPORT_SET call with a five-bit mask, explicit labels, separator, and width so bit order and fixed output width remain observable without table setup.

fixture_notes: The five-bit mask 9 must render on|off|off|on|off from least significant bit to most significant bit.
determinism_notes: The mask, labels, separator, and bit count are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
